routes.name: Short stay (up to 90 days)
routes.summary: Latvia is in Schengen. You need a residence permit to stay more than 90 days in any 6 months. Visa-free list not confirmed.

other: Visa-free countries and fees not confirmed from an official page. Check the foreign ministry visa list.

routes.name: Temporary residence permit: employment or business
routes.summary: Temporary permit for work or commercial activity. Subsistence is double the average gross monthly wage, currently EUR 3,630 per month. Lower amounts apply to some jobs. Employers must register the vacancy for at least 10 working days first.

income.note: Double the average gross monthly wage, valid from 1 April 2026. Other employment: EUR 1,815 per month.

other: Vacancy open at least 10 working days with the State Employment Agency
Russian and Belarusian citizens: new temporary permits are suspended per OCMA

stay.note: Temporary permits run from 6 months up to 5 years depending on the reason.

routes.name: EU Blue Card
routes.summary: Permit for highly qualified workers. Required subsistence is 1.5 times the average gross monthly wage, EUR 2,723 per month, or EUR 2,178 for shortage occupations.

income.note: 1.5x average gross monthly wage. Shortage occupations: EUR 2,178 per month. Valid from 1 April 2026.

other: Other conditions such as degree and contract length not confirmed from an official page.

routes.name: Start-up founder residence permit
routes.summary: OCMA has a guide for start-up founders applying for a residence permit. Requirements were not readable on the page.

other: Conditions not confirmed from an official page.

sources.label: OCMA: Start-up founders and EU Blue Card applicants

routes.name: Temporary residence permit: pensioner
routes.summary: Subsistence for pensioners is double the average monthly old-age pension, currently EUR 1,231 per month.

income.note: Valid from 1 April 2026. Other permit conditions not confirmed.

other: Full conditions not confirmed from an official page.

routes.name: Temporary residence permit: study, family, property
routes.summary: Temporary permits are also issued for study, marriage and real estate purchase. Cases without a specific category use a subsistence base of EUR 780 per month, plus EUR 234 per minor child.

income.note: Applies to cases not covered by other categories. Whether it applies to a given ground is not confirmed.

other: Specific conditions for each ground not confirmed from an official page.

routes.name: Permanent residence permit
routes.summary: Available after at least 5 years on a temporary permit. You need to live in Latvia, show enough means, and know Latvian at A2.

other: At least 5 years on a temporary permit
Repatriates and children of Latvian citizens or non-citizens can get it right away

routes.name: EU long-term resident status
routes.summary: Optional status after 5 years of continuous lawful residence. You need stable income and Latvian at A2.

other: In the last 12 months, earned at least the national minimum wage with taxes paid, or a Latvian pension
Absences up to 6 consecutive months or 10 in total. Blue Card holders get 12 and 18 months for work, volunteering or study in the home country
Study time may count only in part

routes.name: Naturalisation
routes.summary: Apply after 5 years of independent residence in Latvia on a permanent permit. You pass Latvian language and knowledge tests, then take an oath. Dual citizenship is allowed only for some countries.

eligibility.language: Latvian, with written and oral language test
other: Knowledge test on the Constitution, Latvian history and culture, and the anthem text
Legal source of income or support
No terrorism, anti-state or criminal organization record, and no unpaid state taxes
Exemptions exist for Latvian-language education, age 65+, and some disabilities

citizenship.note: You can keep a citizenship of a NATO, EU or EFTA member, Australia, New Zealand, Brazil, or a country with a dual citizenship agreement with Latvia. Otherwise you must renounce before the oath.
